olivia (partnerships): Heads-up — EdgeFuse day-zero kernel probe today at 3:00pm PT. Goal: quick smoke to get a perf/W baseline + surface any obvious kernel hotspots. Partner (edgefuse-eng) will join. Can eng-performance and kernel-team bring a minimal telemetry set we can share? Need to confirm power meter access and what aggregated artifacts are okay to exchange. Link to runbook: https://go/redwood/edgefuse-dayzero :eyes:

kevin (eng-performance): I can bring the profiling image and batch script. Plan: 3 runs (cold, warm, cached). Will add an aggregation flag so we only export top-N hotspots. Need confirmation on the target throughput to aim for during smoke.

lee (kernel-team): Kernel team — heads up that we can produce ftrace/perf but partner asked not to receive raw symbol traces. Propose we only share aggregated hotspots CSV and stack-sample counts. That should be safe.

hannah (bench-ops): I'll reserve racks and PDUs for 2 hours starting 14:45 PT. I'll also plug the power meter into bench logger and make sure bench-bot has access to the CSV. @kevin please include `--export-power` flag.

edgefuse-eng: We can provide power traces (CSV) and our SoC telemetry (freq, temp). We can't share hostnames or raw symbol maps. Also, can you send a short list of perf counters you'd like? We prefer to avoid system-level logs that include identifiable host metrics.

olivia (partnerships): Agreed on aggregated only. Kevin, can you add `--agg-hotspots` and `--export-power=power.csv` to the standard smoke command? We'll also want a small telemetry contract (a minimal set of fields everyone agrees to).

kevin (eng-performance): Yep, updated the smoke command, will push to the runbook in a minute. Example command we'll run:

```
./run_bench.sh --model gpt-small --seq 1024 --batch 8 --runs 3 --agg-hotspots=10 --export-power=power.csv
```

bench-bot: Run queued on rack-42 by @hannah. Estimated runtime ~40m. I will post a condensed summary (throughput, avg power, hotspots CSV) when finished. :robot_face:

lee (kernel-team): For the telemetry contract I propose these headers in the aggregated CSV: `timestamp,power_w,gpu_freq_mhz,gpu_util_pct,kv_cache_hit_rate,hotspot_id,hotspot_self_ms`. I'll drop a tiny JSON schema in GH now (no symbols): https://github.com/redwood/bench-metadata/pulls

hannah (bench-ops): Zoom link for the call: https://zoom.redwood.com/edgefuse-smoke. I'll be oncall and will ssh into rack if anything flakes. @edgefuse-eng please confirm you'll join the call at 3:00.

olivia (partnerships): Follow-ups for today:
- kevin: update runbook with the exact command and attach sample hotspots CSV
- lee: add telemetry contract PR to bench-metadata repo
- edgefuse-eng: confirm power CSV header names match the schema
- hannah: post bench-bot summary and attach raw CSVs to the shared S3 (partner access: read-only)

We'll reconvene in channel at 4:15 PT to review initial findings and decide if we escalate to a deeper kernel dive. :rocket:

edgefuse-eng: Confirmed, we'll join at 3:00 and mute any logs that contain host identifiers. Thanks for organizing.

kevin (eng-performance): PR up with command + sample CSV. See runbook.

bench-bot: Run started at 1769502000. Will post completed summary when done.
